arguments.command:
@'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/core.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/core.py'])
print('Original CRLF:', original.count(b'\r\n'), 'LF:', original.count(b'\n'))
lines = p.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
old = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
import difflib
for tag, i, j, a, b in reversed(list(difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in old], [x.rstrip(b'\r\n') for x in lines]).get_opcodes())):
    if tag == 'equal':
        lines[a:b] = old[i:j]
p.write_bytes(b''.join(lines))
'@ | python -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git --no-pager status --short
arguments.description: Preserve original mixed line endings while keeping edited lines clean
